rounds.text: Shreyans Industries Ltd is heavily undervalued based on its asset backing, trading at a steep discount with a price-to-book ratio of 0.46x against a book value of ₹ 309 per share [E1], which is also notably cheaper than the sector benchmark P/B of 0.77x [E6]. This deep discount sits at the lower end of the market's valuation cycle, with the stock positioned only 17% of the way up its 52-week range [E4]. Furthermore, the business is laying the groundwork for future expansion, evidenced by Capital Work in Progress surging by 270.0% to reach ₹ 37 Cr by March 2026 [E39]. Operational momentum is also showing green shoots through accelerating earnings growth [E65] alongside a positive year-on-year sales increase of 4% [E63]. Conceded: the company is currently experiencing short-term profitability headwinds with a low return on equity of 1% [E28] and a three-year compounded sales contraction of -10% [E15].

The bull leans heavily on the asset backing of a 0.46x price-to-book ratio [E1] and a 52-week range position of 17% [E4], but ignores the severe reality that return on equity has collapsed to 1.5% [E12] and 1% over the last year [E28, E68], making cheap assets structurally unproductive. Conceded: the sector benchmark P/B is 0.77x [E6], which visually flatters the valuation, yet this discount is fully warranted when stacked against a bloated P/E of 30.9x that drastically exceeds the sector benchmark of 14.82x [E5]. The bull points to a 270.0% surge in Capital Work in Progress to ₹ 37 Cr by March 2026 [E39] as a sign of expansion, but ignores that expectations are already running ahead of delivery with price growth exceeding profit growth by 89% [E53], and that historical growth has been weak with a 11.2% poor sales growth rate over five years [E59]. Furthermore, while the bull cites accelerating earnings growth [E65] and a 4% YoY sales increase [E63] as green shoots, these fail to offset a sustained three-year compounded sales contraction of -10% [E15] and a trailing twelve-month sales decline of -1% [E16].
